description: Electricity datasets from French local authorities is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal. The portal listing gives the publisher only as an unfilled template field; the landing pages of the datasets show that five (the EDF substation and the high-voltage lines HTA and HTB) are published by the City of Saint-Denis (La Réunion) on its open-data site and one (Eolienne, wind turbines) by the Communauté d'Agglomération Lisieux-Normandie (CALN). Coverage: Saint-Denis (La Réunion) and the Lisieux-Normandie area. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Poste électrique EDF à Saint Denis; Ligne Haute Tension HTA souterrain; Lignes haute tension HTB Souterrain Saint Denis; Lignes haute tension HTA Aérien Saint Denis. Formats seen: CSV, KML, ZIP, WEB PAGE, GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
